newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle markets not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle markets not tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, USDA said. Trade was slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
On a carcass basis (weight only) Slaughter steers and heifers also were not tested.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 800 Year Ago - 1,500
Wk to Date - None Week Ago - 800 Year Ago - 1,500
